snippet.title: Aquacreep Alpha Walkthrough
snippet.description:
A full spoiler, beginning to end playthrough of a near complete, but still work-in-progress version of the upcoming game " Aquacreep ".

This game will be made available to play before the end of the month, and features gameplay that changes each time you play.

It's set in the "Astrocreep" universe and takes place from the human's perspective trying to figure out which of the members on a ocean research facility is human, and which is the shapeshifting alien in disguise...
